name: Help Scout
description: Help Scout is a customer service platform that centralizes email and other communication channels into a shared inbox, with AI-assisted drafting and a chatbot, to help teams deliver personalized support.
best_for: Positioned for teams of any size (12,000+ companies) across SaaS, ecommerce, education, healthcare, financial services, insurance, manufacturing, and professional services.
features: Unified shared inbox aggregating email, social, Shopify, and other channels
AI drafting/editing and automated thread recaps/translation
Beacon AI chatbot (resolves ~73% of interactions per site claim)
Custom help center / embeddable support hub
Workflow automation and saved reply templates
Proactive in-app messaging, surveys, and NPS collection

alternatives.name: Front
alternatives.description: An AI customer operations platform unifying shared inboxes, ticketing, and live chat for complex cross-team workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Operations, support, sales, and account-management teams needing cross-team coordination.

alternatives.name: Crisp
alternatives.description: An all-in-one support platform combining AI agents, live chat, and a shared inbox for companies of any size.
alternatives.best_for: Startups to enterprises wanting a lightweight, chat-first support and marketing tool.
strengths: Live chat widget with mobile SDKs
